{'test_behavior': 'Verify parsing of special string values, equality behavior with same precision, and copySign/signum/absolute value behavior.\n', 'test_name': 'testSpecialValuesAndBasicSignOperations\n', 'test_code': '@Test\npublic void testSpecialValuesAndBasicSignOperations() {\n    DfpField field = new DfpField(5);\n\n    Dfp posInf = field.newDfp("Infinity");\n    Dfp negInf = field.newDfp("-Infinity");\n    Dfp nan = field.newDfp("NaN");\n    Dfp zero = field.getZero();\n    Dfp negZero = field.newDfp(-0.0);\n    Dfp two = field.getTwo();\n    Dfp negTwo = field.newDfp(-2);\n\n    assertTrue(posInf.isInfinite());\n    assertTrue(negInf.isInfinite());\n    assertTrue(nan.isNaN());\n    assertEquals("Infinity", posInf.toString());\n    assertEquals("-Infinity", negInf.toString());\n    assertEquals("NaN", nan.toString());\n\n    assertTrue(zero.equals(negZero));\n    assertFalse(nan.equals(nan));\n    assertTrue(two.greaterThan(zero));\n    assertTrue(negTwo.lessThan(zero));\n    assertTrue(negTwo.negativeOrNull());\n    assertTrue(two.positiveOrNull());\n    assertTrue(negTwo.strictlyNegative());\n    assertTrue(two.strictlyPositive());\n\n    Dfp abs = negTwo.abs();\n    assertEquals(two, abs);\n\n    Dfp copied = Dfp.copysign(two, negTwo);\n    assertEquals("-2.0000", copied.toString());\n    assertEquals(two, two.signum());\n    assertEquals(negTwo, negTwo.signum());\n    assertEquals(zero, zero.signum());\n    assertTrue(copied.copySign(two).greaterThan(zero));\n    assertTrue(copied.copySign(-0.0).greaterThan(zero));\n}\n', 'new_imports_code': 'import static org.junit.Assert.*;\nimport org.junit.Test;\n'}
